title: Craftzone
summary: An app for finding services and service providers nearby. I led the team, revamped the interface and shipped a ticketing system with in-app chat.
screenSlots: Before vs after of the UI revamp

caseStudy.overview: Craftzone lets people find services and service providers around them quickly.
contribution: Led the team developing the product.
Revamped the previous interface to improve the user experience.
Built new features, including a ticketing system with chat.
Published updates to the Google Play Store.
caseStudy.approach: Clean coding standards, modular code and object-oriented design, with test-driven development where it made sense.
